context: Member of batch release-v2-remediation. GUARDRAILS: no change to oracle policy, reviewer roles or required checks; never relax oracle-gate. DECISION GATE: removing or replacing a required check, or changing the `oracle` environment, is an owner action.
description: Owner decision 2026-11-05: Theseus (joeharris76/theseus) is consumed at a pinned SHA like a dependency. Today the pin appears in oracle-verdict.yml and oracle-gate.yml (both 'uses' and 'theseus_ref'), and #3942 showed a bump can take every merge down. Deliver: (1) a single source of truth for the pin, with a test that all references match; (2) a documented bump procedure: canary PR set (at least one trivial PR and one PR with a known defect) whose verdict and gate must post and behave correctly on the new pin before merge, plus the rv2r-06 posting detector green; (3) rollback = revert the pin commit, written as a runbook with the exact steps; (4) bumps blocked during a release window via the rv2r-08 guard.
